title: Generalized Prediction Set with Bandit Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.20387v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In high-stakes environments where uncertainties abound, set-valued prediction offers a cautious and robust mechanism by presenting multiple potential labels as the prediction for each test instance to mitigate the potential risk associated with prediction errors. Yet, integrating this paradigm with out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains scarcely explored in such settings as online learning with bandit feedback. The bandit feedback mechanism informs the learner about the correctness of the pulled arm/action instead of the explicit ground truth label, leaving the true class label unknown when an incorrect action is taken. To address this challenge, we introduce BanditGPS which conducts set-valued prediction with OOD detection in the bandit feedback setting, using an estimation to the ground truth of class labels. translated_title: 基于赌博机反馈的广义预测集
translated_abstract: 在充满不确定性的高风险环境中，集合值预测通过为每个测试实例给出多个潜在标签作为预测，提供了一种谨慎且稳健的机制，以降低预测错误带来的潜在风险。然而，在诸如带赌博机反馈的在线学习等场景下，将这一范式与分布外（OOD）检测相结合的研究仍然很少。赌博机反馈机制只告知学习者所选择的臂/动作是否正确，而不是显式的真实标签，因此当采取错误动作时，真实的类别标签是未知的。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了BanditGPS，它在赌博机反馈设置下进行带OOD检测的集合值预测，并利用对类别标签真实值的估计。BanditGPS实现了三个目标：给出小而富有信息量的预测集、提升OOD检测性能，以及
tldr: 提出BanditGPS，首次在赌博机反馈的在线学习设置下实现结合OOD检测的集合值预测，通过对真实类别标签的估计，生成小而信息丰富的预测集并提升OOD检测性能。
en_tdlr: BanditGPS is the first framework to perform set-valued prediction with OOD detection under bandit feedback, estimating the true class labels to produce small and informative prediction sets while enhancing OOD detection performance.
